visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with black hair pulled back, wearing a white dress, holds a yellow children's book titled "Quantum Physics for Babies." She is positioned in a modern living room with a wooden bookshelf to her right. The lighting is bright and even. She smiles while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a wider shot where the woman stands next to a three-tier revolving bookshelf. The bookshelf features white cloud-shaped side panels and is filled with various colorful children's books. She gestures with her right hand towards the bookshelf, emphasizing its design. The background is a clean interior. (3) The camera focuses on the baby on a play mat near the revolving shelf. The baby interacts with the bottom tier. Then, a hand is shown spinning the shelf smoothly, highlighting its 360-degree rotation. The background includes a dining area reflected in a large mirror. Text overlays appear at the bottom. (4) The woman demonstrates the shelf's stability by leaning her weight onto the top tier and shaking it vigorously. She gives a thumbs-up gesture. Different versions of the shelf with mountain and rainbow designs are showcased briefly in a montage. She continues speaking to the viewer with expressive hand movements.

The background music swells slightly in volume during this product demonstration phase to maintain energy levels. The acoustic texture is clean with high spectral brightness. The music remains continuous until the very end, where it softly fades out as the woman finishes speaking. The overall production quality sounds professional with good dynamic range.
